title: Use a named set of choices
summary: GraphQL: Use a named set of choices. Return RED instead.
introduction: An enum limits a value to named choices. GREEN is a schema label, not arbitrary text.
learningObjectives: Use a named set of choices with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.
Use a named set of choices

blocks.title: Use a named set of choices

blocks.text: The resolver returns GREEN, which is a legal enum value. JSON represents the enum name as text.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The resolver result must match an enum value.
